decisions.decision: The runtime blocker was not stale binaries or host crash, but the absence of a real named pipe server.
decisions.rationale: dlp-drive-host.rs calls CreateFileW on the pipe name immediately; if no pipe instance exists, the open fails and the process exits with code 2 before any visible diagnostics.

decisions.decision: Implement synchronous pipe I/O on both service and host for this iteration.
decisions.rationale: Overlapped I/O adds complexity and is unnecessary for the single-actor bootstrap/control channel in Phase 1.

decisions.decision: Keep the pipe DACL limited to the captured user SID only (no service SID) so only the intended user-session host can connect.
decisions.rationale: The LocalSystem service owns the pipe handle; the client must be the captured user. Adding other SIDs would widen the attack surface.

Then update dlp-drive-host.rs to use synchronous CreateFileW and safe drive-letter selection.
